report.title: Memos Detail Sidebar renders values as [object Object]
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Demo site (demo.usememos.com) ### Memos Version v0.25.3 ### Bug Description Opening the Memo Detail page shows the sidebar with data and tag information, the dates however are rendered as `[object Object]` The alt text on the posted time (the one under the username, e.g. `2 minutes ago`) does however show a date, so some time information seems to exist. Furthermore the protobuf message yielded from the `GetMemo` API endpoint does not seem to contain any datetime information: `` ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Post a Memo 2. Open the Memo detail view 3. Observe the sidebar widget ### Expected Behavior I expected the time information in the Memo Detail Sidebar to be rendered properly ### Screenshots & Additional Context - Browser: Firefox - OS: Linux

preconditions: the app has no memos yet; the test user is signed in
steps: Type a short memo text such as "test memo" into the memo editor on the home page
Click the Save button to post the memo
Click the new memo's timestamp (or open the memo) to open the Memo detail page
Look at the detail sidebar widget showing date/time information
plan.expected: the Memo detail sidebar shows readable date/time values (for example a formatted created and updated date) and the text "[object Object]" does not appear anywhere in the sidebar
plan.reported_actual: The date values in the Memo detail sidebar are rendered as "[object Object]" instead of a formatted date, while the tooltip on the posted time under the username shows a date
missing: What memo content was posted (any memo content is assumed to trigger the issue; the reporter's memo had nested tags)
Whether the bug appears on the latest version or only v0.25.3
assumed: the sidebar is visible on a desktop-width window
assumed: any new memo is enough to trigger the bug, with the reporter's tag content not required
assumed: the memo detail page is opened by clicking the memo's timestamp
plan.summary: Memo detail sidebar shows [object Object] instead of formatted dates

## Reproduce the report

Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Type a short memo text such as "test memo" into the memo editor on the home page
2. Click the Save button to post the memo
3. Click the new memo's timestamp (or open the memo) to open the Memo detail page
4. Look at the detail sidebar widget showing date/time information
The reporter says the correct behavior is that the Memo detail sidebar shows readable date/time values (for example a formatted created and updated date) and the text "[object Object]" does not appear anywhere in the sidebar.
